The '''''Scythe''-class bomber''' was an [[Adumar/Legends|Adumari]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] mainly used for [[Bomber/Legends|bombing]] ground targets.

==History==
The ''Scythe''-class played a huge part in the brief [[Adumari Civil War]], a number of them flying for the coalition of nations against [[Cartann]]. Catching the Cartann forces unprepared, they destroyed a huge number of grounded fighters in that conflict.<ref name="soa" />

==Appearances==
*''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''
